name: agent-wallet-codex
description: Non-custodial agent wallet toolkit plus a gated Solidity workflow: wallets, send, receive, swap, sign, and write, audit and deploy contracts across EVM and Bitcoin, straight to chain.

interface.shortDescription: Non-custodial on-chain wallet and Solidity workflow for agents
interface.longDescription: Create and import wallets, check balances, send native coin, ERC-20 and BTC, swap via DEX aggregators, and run a gated Solidity workflow that walks spec, threat model, design, implementation, an in-process EVM proof, a security audit and deployment. Keys stay on your machine, encrypted; transactions go straight to public RPC endpoints. The contract sandbox needs no Foundry, no node and no funds.
defaultPrompt: Use the agent-wallet skill to create a wallet, check a balance, or send funds on-chain.
Use the agent-solidity skill to write, audit or deploy a smart contract.
